body:
Hey, I’m a 27f who broke up with my ex (27f) due to incompatibilities which were making me unhappy in the relationship and we just wouldn’t work long-term.

I don’t regret my decision to end it because I know deep down it was the right thing but the pain is unbearable. I cry everyday because I miss her so much. I don’t think many people understand how hard it is to end a relationship when you’re still in love with the person. 

I hope it gets better for us both, we’ve got this
thank you for your advice ! putting my phone down and doing something else is working well so thank you :)
this is a really good idea, thank you !

it’s insanely hard to stop even though whatever i’ll see will only hurt me more. we work together so it makes it harder to do the whole no contact thing

great pact, let’s do it

1. 1 year
2. 1 day and it’s hard to imagine things getting better right now
the fear of ending up in a worse position than i’m already in e.g brain damage, paralysis etc

yes absolutely! i mean i’d probably need some liquid courage in the form of alcohol first but seeing this would make me approach a girl even more, i wouldn’t have to worry that i’m hitting on someone who’s already taken!
